summary: Rubico Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its semi-annual financial report for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing discloses routine operational items, including vessel acquisitions, newbuilding commitments, related-party transactions, and financing arrangements. No extraordinary corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring is indicated. The filing is a periodic report, not a special-situation event.
